title: priceRanges entered as floats being truncated to integers
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**

Bug

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

In instantsearch.js 1.11.7, the priceRanges and priceRange widgets truncate manually entered values to integers.  This makes it hard to search for small values in ranges like 0.00 to 0.50.

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

instantsearch.js accepts manually entered numbers as integers or floats.

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**

All.

**Bug: What is the proposed solution?**

I don't have a patch or test case for you.  You can use the instantsearch.js example on this page to see the problem:

https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v1/documentation/#priceranges

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**

1.11.7
